eddies-civ-mod.handbook.title: Civ handbook
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_1:
§lEddies Civ Mod§r

Found towns, elect mayors and parliaments, pass laws, trade, run companies and go to court.

/civ help – all commands
/civ menu – town menu
/civ web – website
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_2:
§lFounding a town§r

Craft a town hall: emerald, stone bricks, bell (ESE/SBS/ESE). Name it in an anvil and place it. Right-click opens the menu.

Join: /civ join <name>
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_3:
§lTerritory§r

Claim chunks: town hall → claim chunk or /civ claim. The plot wand cuts plots; sell, lease and assign them in the plots menu.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_4:
§lMoney§r

Deposit emeralds at the bank: /civ deposit. Transfer: /civ transfer <player> <amount>. The market block (/civ price shows prices) buys and sells almost anything at prices that follow supply and demand.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_5:
§lLaw§r

Town hall → rules: taxes, building, PvP, voting systems and more. With "laws by vote" the citizens decide. Constitution and statute book exist as block and item.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_6:
§lElections§r

/civ election call <office>
/civ election run <office> [platform]
/civ election vote <office> <name>

After the polls close a live count with projections runs. Parliaments use proportional or majority systems.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_7:
§lCampaigning§r

Give speeches (/civ speech), put up poster columns, make promises, found parties (/civ party). On the last election day there is a debate: /civ debate <text>.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_8:
§lVillagers§r

Villagers in your territory become residents, pay into the treasury and vote by personality. Unhappy villagers move away. See town hall → mood.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_9:
§lCompanies§r

/civ company found <capital> <name>
/civ company branch <company> forst
/civ company hire <company> <player|villager> <wage>
/civ company invest <company> <amount>
Menu: /civ company menu <company>
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_10:
§lOutput§r

Every evening a company produces goods (wood, wool, wheat, ore …). More workers and better equipment yield more. Sell automatically to the market or by hand: /civ company stock, collect, selling.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_11:
§lStock exchange§r

Companies are listed: /civ exchange, buy, sell, portfolio. Management pays profits as dividends. Newspapers report and sway elections.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_12:
§lCourt§r

Sue: /civ court sue straf|zivil|verfassung …
File: /civ court case <no>
There: evidence from your hand, testimony, witnesses, closing arguments, verdict and appeal. The judge's bench block opens the court.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_13:
§lFederations and symbols§r

Towns join into states and nations: /civ federation. Each level has its own commands (/civ state …), districts, flag (banner) and anthem.
eddies-civ-mod.handbook.page_14:
§lDaily life§r

Friends: /civ friend <name>, trust grants building rights. Mail: mailbox block. Contracts: /civ contract. The website (/civ web) has the map, elections, exchange, press, justice and chat.
